005package org.wpilib.smartdashboard;
006
007import java.util.HashMap;
008import java.util.Map;
009import java.util.Map.Entry;
010import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryLoggable;
011import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryTable;
012
013/**
014 * Common base class for all Mechanism2d node types.
015 *
016 * <p>To append another node, call {@link #append(MechanismObject2d)}. Objects that aren't appended
017 * to a published {@link Mechanism2d} container are nonfunctional.
018 *
019 * @see Mechanism2d
020 */
021public abstract class MechanismObject2d implements TelemetryLoggable {
022  /** Relative to parent. */
023  private final String m_name;
024
025  private final Map<String, MechanismObject2d> m_objects = new HashMap<>(1);
026
027  /**
028   * Create a new Mechanism node object.
029   *
030   * @param name the node's name, must be unique.
031   */
032  protected MechanismObject2d(String name) {
033    m_name = name;
034  }
035
036  /**
037   * Append a Mechanism object that is based on this one.
038   *
039   * @param <T> The object type.
040   * @param object the object to add.
041   * @return the object given as a parameter, useful for variable assignments and call chaining.
042   * @throws UnsupportedOperationException if the object's name is already used - object names must
043   *     be unique.
044   */
045  public final synchronized <T extends MechanismObject2d> T append(T object) {
046    if (m_objects.containsKey(object.getName())) {
047      throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Mechanism object names must be unique!");
048    }
049    m_objects.put(object.getName(), object);
050    return object;
051  }
052
053  /**
054   * Retrieve the object's name.
055   *
056   * @return the object's name relative to its parent.
057   */
058  public final String getName() {
059    return m_name;
060  }
061
062  @Override
063  public void logTo(TelemetryTable table) {
064    synchronized (this) {
065      for (Entry<String, MechanismObject2d> entry : m_objects.entrySet()) {
066        table.log(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
067      }
068    }
069  }
070}
